top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, clinically confirmed discovery chain: incretin physiology (Holst), the proglucagon-derived active GLP-1 peptide (Mojsov) and the hormone's biology (Drucker), which made incretin-based treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity possible. Allocation to three names fits the cap and the citation stays at hormone physiology and active peptide without adjudicating priority. No award is a clearly worse outcome than a well-supported, field-changing prize.
